lines.en: : Noriko, hurry the fuck up. We don’t have enough time to look at stupid vegetarian food alternatives when starvation is always a viable option.
lines.zh: : Noriko，他妈的快点。在「饿死」永远是个可行选项的时候，我们可没那么多时间去看什么愚蠢的素食替代品。

lines.en: : Nee-chan, should you really be encouraging your little sister to starve? Your life would be incomplete without me and I ask that you take that back immediately or I will be forced to die.
lines.zh: : 姐，你真的该鼓励自己的妹妹去饿死吗？没有我，你的人生就不完整，我要求你立刻收回那句话，否则我就只能去死了。

lines.en: : Fine, don’t starve. But still, hurry the fuck up. The whole purpose of us going out today was to buy things for {i}Ami.{/i} And unless you’re planning on converting her-
lines.zh: : 行，别饿死。但还是他妈的快点。我们今天出来的全部目的，是给 {i}Ami{/i} 买东西。除非你打算把她也发展成——

lines.en: : Ami, want to go vegetarian with me? I can show you all of the best spots in town.
lines.zh: : Ami，要不要跟我一起吃素？我可以带你去镇上所有最棒的店。

lines.en: : I...don’t think I should. I’m not sure how Sensei would feel about that when he’s basically subjected to eating the same thing as me every night.
lines.zh: : 我……我觉得不太好。老师每天晚上基本都得跟着我吃一样的东西，我不确定他会怎么想。

lines.en: : Ugh. Ami, as much as I believe you’re making the right choice, you really shouldn’t be basing all of your decisions on how your uncle feels about them.
lines.zh: : 唉。Ami，虽然我相信你做的是正确的选择，可你真的不该把所有的决定都建立在叔叔对它们的感受上。

lines.en: : Uh...are you sure that {i}you’re{/i} qualified to be saying that, Nee-chan? Your entire career started out of spite for him.
lines.zh: : 呃……姐，你确定{i}你{/i}有资格说这话吗？你的整个职业生涯，可都是从跟他赌气开始的。

lines.en: : Yes, Noriko. But my {i}success{/i} is due to the fact that I am talented and beautiful and wasn’t bogged down by that asshole’s depressive ramblings during my golden years.
lines.zh: : 是的，Noriko。但我的{i}成功{/i}靠的是我有才华、长得美，还有在我最黄金的岁月里，没有被那个混蛋的抑郁胡话给拖累。

lines.en: : I think we both know how you’d have really preferred to spend those “golden years.” And also, Akira isn’t Ami’s uncle anymore. He’s her dad now.
lines.zh: : 我们都心知肚明，你其实更想怎么度过那些「黄金岁月」。还有，Akira 已经不是 Ami 的叔叔了。他现在是她爸爸。

lines.en: : Oh, right. Sorry. That’s gonna take some getting used to for me.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。抱歉。这个我得花点时间习惯。

lines.en: : I think it’s gonna take some getting used to for pretty much everyone. It’s fine, though. It doesn’t really matter what other people call him so long as I can call him that.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这对几乎所有人来说都得花点时间习惯。不过没关系。别人怎么叫他其实不重要，只要我能那么叫他就行。

lines.en: : Has anything changed at all since you’ve {i}started{/i} calling him that? Any...talks, maybe?
lines.zh: : 从你{i}开始{/i}那么叫他以后，有什么变化吗？有没有……谈过什么，也许？

lines.en: : Also, is he giving you an allowance? Because I don’t want you buying anything for yourself today, but-
lines.zh: : 还有，他给你零花钱吗？因为我今天不想让你给自己买任何东西，不过——

lines.en: : I don’t get an allowance. I get all of my pocket money from my job at the maid cafe.
lines.zh: : 我没有零花钱。我所有的零用钱都是从女仆咖啡厅打工挣的。

lines.en: : The one I did the promo at? They’re still there?
lines.zh: : 就是我做宣传的那家？他们还开着？

lines.en: : Yup! And as of next week, I’ll be ready to return and ready to make money again! You should come visit sometime soon. There’s a girl there who’s {i}obsessed{/i} with you.
lines.zh: : 嗯！而且下周开始，我就能回去重新赚钱了！你什么时候该来看看。那里有个女孩对你特别{i}着迷{/i}。

lines.en: : It’s that Chika girl I told you about.
lines.zh: : 就是我跟你说过的那个 Chika。

lines.en: : The one with the little sister who wanted my autograph?
lines.zh: : 就是那个有个妹妹想要我签名的？

lines.en: : That’s what she said at least, but there’s like a 99%% chance that autograph was just for her.
lines.zh: : 至少她是这么说的，不过那个签名大概有 99%% 的可能性其实就是她自己要的。

lines.en: : I don’t care who it was for. I sign autographs all the time. But Ami, there’s no way I can go back to that place. They’ll recognize me immediately, disguise or not.
lines.zh: : 我不在乎那是给谁的。我签的名多了去了。可是 Ami，我绝对不可能回那种地方去。不管怎么乔装，他们一眼就能认出我来。

lines.en: : Come to think of it, it’s really weird that {i}more{/i} people don’t recognize you while you’re in disguise. You’ve got a pretty {i}noticeable{/i} appearance, Nee-chan.
lines.zh: : 说起来也真奇怪，你乔装的时候居然没{i}更多{/i}人认出你。你的外形可是相当{i}显眼{/i}啊，姐。

lines.en: : Blame Mom and Dad for strengthening the pink hair gene. Ami, where do you want to go next? Victoria’s Secret? UNIQLO? Or maybe Undercover so Noriko can get lost and we can run away together?
lines.zh: : 要怪就怪爸妈把粉发基因强化得太好了。Ami，接下来想去哪儿？维多利亚的秘密？优衣库？还是 Undercover，好让 Noriko 走丢，我们就能一起私奔了？
: 我确实很喜欢那家店。

lines.en: : Anywhere is fine, Niki. I’m happy enough that you decided to take me out. Never in a million years would I have even {i}dreamed{/i} of going shopping with you.
lines.zh: : 去哪儿都行，Niki。你愿意带我出来，我就已经够开心了。我{i}做梦{/i}都没想过能和你一起逛街。

lines.en: : Oh, shut up. You’re family. Let’s go to Victoria’s Secret. I know people there. I can get you free underwear.
lines.zh: : 哦，闭嘴啦。你是一家人。我们去维多利亚的秘密吧。我在那儿有人。能给你弄到免费的内衣。

lines.en: : What’s wrong with the underwear I have now?
lines.zh: : 我现在穿的内衣有什么问题吗？

lines.en: : It’s so...plain. Here’s your lesson for the day — confidence stems from what you’ve got on {i}beneath{/i} your clothes, Ami. If you want to feel good about yourself, you need to-
lines.zh: : 太……朴素了。这就是今天给你上的一课——自信来自你衣服{i}底下{/i}穿了什么，Ami。如果你想对自己感觉良好，你就得——

lines.en: : Hey...isn’t that girl over there the one who’s been showing up at our special events lately?
lines.zh: : 嘿……那边那个女孩，不就是最近老在我们特殊活动上出现的那个吗？
: 我这边看不太清——

lines.en: : Hey, don’t pay attention to Noriko while I’m teaching you valuable life lessons.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我在给你上有用的人生课的时候，别去管 Noriko。

lines.en: : Oh! S...Sorry! So, what’s wrong with my underwear exactly?
lines.zh: : 哦！对……对不起！那我的内衣到底哪里有问题？
: 问题就在于你——

lines.en: : Nee-chan, Ami, you two can go on without me for a little while. I’ll catch up with you when you’re ready to grab lunch or something.
lines.zh: : 姐，Ami，你们俩先走一会儿，不用管我。等你们要去吃午饭什么的，我再去找你们。

lines.en: : Okay, guess we’re not going to Undercover then. Which is fine. They don’t really have anything in my style anyway. Come on, Ami! Let’s go! Time to bond!
lines.zh: : 好吧，看来是不去 Undercover 了。也没关系。反正他们家也没有适合我风格的东西。走吧，Ami！我们走！联络感情的时间到了！

lines.en: : Are you sure it’s okay to leave Noriko alone-
lines.zh: : 把 Noriko 一个人留下真的没关系吗——

lines.en: : Noriko’s fine. We come here all the time. Bye, little sister! Don’t get into any strange vans! Ami, come.
lines.zh: : Noriko 没问题的。我们经常来这儿。拜拜，小妹！别上什么奇怪的面包车！Ami，走啦。
: 啊……好的！
: 拜拜，Noriko！

lines.en: : Hi there! My name’s Noriko. You’re that girl who’s always walking around with the waitress, right?
lines.zh: : 你好呀！我叫 Noriko。你就是老跟那个女服务生一起走来走去的那个女孩吧？

lines.en: : Are you lost? Do you need me to help you find her?
lines.zh: : 你迷路了吗？需要我帮你找她吗？
: 这么说你{i}确实{/i}是迷路了？

lines.en: : You went out exploring together and got distracted by a fancy mug at a thrift store?
lines.zh: : 你们一起出来探险，然后她被二手店里的一个花哨马克杯给吸引住了？

lines.en: : Oh. Yeah. I’ve got a knack for figuring out what people are trying to say without actually hearing them. My sister says it’s my “kind heart” or something like that.
lines.zh: : 哦。对。我有种本事，不用真的听见，也能猜出别人想说什么。我姐说那是我的「善良的心」之类的。

lines.en: : I can do it with animals too, you know.
lines.zh: : 我对动物也能这样，你知道吗。

lines.en: : Yeah? You like animals? What’s your favorite kind?
lines.zh: : 是吗？你喜欢动物？最喜欢哪种？

lines.en: : Oh, interesting! I don’t think I’ve ever heard of that one before.
lines.zh: : 哦，有意思！我以前好像从没听说过那种动物。

lines.en: : Come on. I’ll help you look for the waitress lady. We can hold hands so you don’t get distracted and wind up getting lost again, okay?
lines.zh: : 来吧。我帮你找那个女服务生。我们可以牵着手，这样你就不会分心、又走丢了，好吗？

lines.en: : No, I’m not going to {i}abduct{/i} you. I’m not one of the “bad people” she warned you about. I’m nice.
lines.zh: : 不，我不会{i}拐走{/i}你的。我不是她警告过你的那种「坏人」。我是好人。

lines.en: : Yes, I...know that’s exactly what a bad person would say. But you can trust me! The whole reason I came over here was because you looked lost and-
lines.zh: : 是啊，我……知道坏人也会这么说。但你可以相信我！我之所以过来，纯粹是因为你看起来迷路了，而且——

lines.en: : Ah! You were just messing with me, weren’t you! The nerve of kids these days!
lines.zh: : 啊！你刚才是在耍我玩，对吧！现在的孩子可真够大胆的！

lines.en: : Now, where do you think we should start looking? Where did you two first get separated?
lines.zh: : 那么，你觉得我们该从哪儿开始找？你们俩是在哪儿走散的？

lines.en: : Where the fuck am I?! Why is everything so wet?!
lines.zh: : 我他妈到底在哪儿？！为什么到处都是湿的？！

lines.en: : And why am I holding an egg?!
lines.zh: : 还有我为什么手里拿着一个鸡蛋？！

lines.en: : Noriko Nakayama — please report to the principal’s office.
lines.zh: : 中山 Noriko——请到校长室报到。
: 请到——

lines.en: : This has gotta be a dream, right?
lines.zh: : 这肯定是在做梦，对吧？
: 这不是梦。

lines.en: : Like {i}fuck{/i} it’s not a dream, disembodied PA voice! I’ve never heard a school announcement {i}respond{/i} before! And this isn’t even my school!
lines.zh: : {i}去你的{/i}「这不是梦」，你这个没有身体的广播声音！我还从没听过校园广播会{i}回应{/i}人呢！而且这根本不是我的学校！
: 这是所有人的学校。

lines.en: : The time is currently 7:31 PM. Today’s forecast is partly cloudy with a chance of nightfall.
lines.zh: : 现在的时间是晚上 7 点 31 分。今天的天气预报是多云，有夜幕降临的可能。

lines.en: : You are happy here. There is no reason for you to leave.
lines.zh: : 你在这里很幸福。你没有理由离开。

lines.en: : Okay, sure. But why am I holding an egg?
lines.zh: : 好，行吧。可是我为什么拿着一个鸡蛋？
: 有理由的。

lines.en: : Alright. I’ve seriously gotta lay off the melatonin before bed. I’ve heard of it causing nightmares, but this is just flat out weird.
lines.zh: : 好吧。我睡前真的得戒掉褪黑素了。我听说过它会导致噩梦，可这也太他妈离谱了。

lines.en: : One second I’m shopping with Ami and Nee-chan, the next I have to bring an egg to the principal at 7:31 PM. That makes total sense.
lines.zh: : 上一秒我还在跟 Ami 和姐逛街，下一秒我就得在晚上 7 点 31 分把一个鸡蛋送到校长那儿去。这逻辑完全说得通嘛。

lines.en: : Noriko Nakayama — your attendance is required for the Transpacific Sadness Symposium in nine minutes.
lines.zh: : 中山 Noriko——九分钟后，你需要出席跨太平洋悲伤研讨会。
: Maya？……
: 跨太平洋……悲伤研讨会？……

lines.en: : Your guide is waiting just beyond the door. Please dry off your shoes and follow her to the best of your ability — but be warned.
lines.zh: : 你的向导就在门后等你。请把鞋擦干，尽你所能地跟上去——但要先警告你。

lines.en: : She skitters like a crab. And for every leg that snaps at the joint, a piece of you will be removed.
lines.zh: : 她会像螃蟹一样横着疾走。而她每有一条腿在关节处折断，你身上就会被削掉一块。

lines.en: : Like...my clothes? Because I’ve had some weird sex dreams before, but nothing even close to this.
lines.zh: : 比如……我的衣服？我之前也做过一些怪异的春梦，但没有一个能跟这个比的。
: 这不是梦。

lines.en: : This is a replica of Heaven. This is the {b}DEN OF THE MOLE RAT.{/b}
lines.zh: : 这是天堂的复制品。这里是{b}鼹鼠之巢{/b}。

lines.en: : Are you...a part of the dream as well?...
lines.zh: : 你……也是这个梦的一部分吗？……

lines.en: : Please tell me you’re a part of the dream. Because the last thing I want to hear is that you got sucked in here {i}with{/i} me and that all of this is actually happening.
lines.zh: : 拜托告诉我你是梦的一部分。因为我最不想听到的，就是你被{i}跟我一起{/i}卷进了这里，而这一切其实正在真实发生。

lines.en: : You want me to go that way?...
lines.zh: : 你想让我往那边走？……

lines.en: : Oh, hell no! I’ve watched enough horror movies to know that I’m never supposed to follow a little girl down a dark hallway! That’s how people die!
lines.zh: : 哦，绝对不行！我看了够多恐怖片了，知道跟着一个小女孩走进昏暗的走廊是绝对不行的！人就是那么死的！

lines.en: : But...I also know that people die by staying somewhere they aren’t meant to be for too long and...
lines.zh: : 但是……我也知道，人在不该待的地方待太久同样会死，而且……
: 啊啊啊！烦死了！

lines.en: : Little girl! How do I get out of this creepy dream?! I don’t even have the egg anymore! It vanished when I walked out of the bathroom!
lines.zh: : 小女孩！我该怎么从这个瘆人的梦里出去？！我连鸡蛋都没有了！我一走出洗手间它就不见了！

lines.en: : I know I told you I could understand you before, but that was {i}prior{/i} to my brain having to come to terms with whatever is going on right now! So if you {i}can{/i} talk, please do so!
lines.zh: : 我知道我之前跟你说过我能听懂你，但那是在我的大脑被迫接受现在这场状况{i}之前{/i}的事了！所以如果你{i}能{/i}说话，拜托你说吧！

lines.en: : Ugh...who am I kidding? She’s clearly a part of this. And of course that means I’m going to have to play along until I get to the “scare” that wakes me up. Fantastic.
lines.zh: : 唉……我骗谁呢？她显然就是这鬼地方的一部分。那当然就意味着，我得一直陪着演下去，直到那个能把我吓醒的「惊吓」出现。太棒了。

lines.en: : This is {i}not{/i} a good self-introduction! I hope you know that! Because it’s really going to taint the way I look at you from now on!
lines.zh: : 这可算{i}不{/i}上什么好的自我介绍！我希望你明白这点！因为它真的会污染我今后看你的眼光！
: {i}断片式性爱……真的是最棒的……{/i}
: {i}Maya？……{/i}
: {i}哎呀，哎呀，哎呀……{/i}
: {i}看看是谁……终于决定现身了……{/i}
: {i}我们不能——{/i}
: {i}你敢……他妈的停下来……{/i}
: {i}我再重复一遍……{/i}{i}你敢停下来试试……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}God that feels so good. Holy shit.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}天啊，太舒服了。操。{/i}
: 通过广播？……真的假的？……

lines.en: : Girl seriously takes cucking me to the next level, doesn’t she?
lines.zh: : 这丫头是真把我被绿这件事玩出新高度了，是吧？
: 行！好吧！

lines.en: : Anything that gets me away from {i}this!{/i}
lines.zh: : 只要能让我离开{i}这里{/i}，什么都行！

lines.en: There are special areas that exist in places and times that only gods would look.
lines.zh: 有一些特殊的区域，存在于只有神才会去注视的地点和时间里。

lines.en: Hidden from the prying eye of the common man and tucked between the moon and its siblings, these places make wishes come true.
lines.zh: 它们避开了凡人窥探的眼睛，被塞进月亮和它的兄弟姐妹之间，而这些地方能让愿望成真。

lines.en: No one finds them on accident and no one leaves them on purpose.
lines.zh: 没有人会偶然发现它们，也没有人会主动离开它们。

lines.en: They exist. I promise. But only if you believe in them.
lines.zh: 它们存在。我保证。但前提是你相信它们。

lines.en: If you can separate yourself from where you’re meant to be in the time you’re meant to be there, the limits of where you can be and when are endless.
lines.zh: 如果你能在你本该在的时间里，把自己从你本该在的地方剥离出来，那么你在何处、在何时的界限，便是无穷无尽的。

lines.en: Let’s ride the mole rat together — let’s see where it takes us. Let’s fill our mouths with dirt and rocks, swallowing bit by precious bit until our stomachs are gardens.
lines.zh: 让我们一起骑上那只鼹鼠——看看它会带我们去哪儿。让我们把泥土和石块塞满嘴巴，一口一口珍贵地吞下去，直到我们的胃变成花园。

lines.en: Let’s hold each other’s hands. Let’s sew them together. Let’s bite each other’s tongues until our mouths taste like metal. And let’s do all of it not because we want to, but because we can’t.
lines.zh: 让我们握住彼此的手。让我们把手缝在一起。让我们咬住彼此的舌头，直到嘴里尝到金属的味道。而我们做这一切，不是因为我们想，而是因为我们停不下来。

lines.en: Water and oil don’t mix — just like greenery and gasoline or a schoolgirl’s special sex-mound with the Southern White Rhino — both just one wrong move away from non-existence.
lines.zh: 水和油无法相融——就像绿植和汽油，或者一个女学生那特殊的性器官和白犀牛——两者都只需一个错误的动作，就会归于虚无。

lines.en: There exists a place that you can touch in an area your hands won’t reach. Where flowers won’t bloom and bodies won’t rot.
lines.zh: 有一个地方，你的手够不到，却能触碰得到。在那里，花不会开，尸体也不会腐烂。

lines.en: The water in the pipes has been there for ages and the floors are barely clinging to life in a world all but devoid of it.
lines.zh: 水管里的水已经存在了无数岁月，而地板也只是在这个几乎毫无生机的世界里勉强吊着一口气。

lines.en: I think Heaven is a classroom and God is the chalkboard.
lines.zh: 我觉得天堂是一间教室，而神是那块黑板。

lines.en: I think that’s where I want to go when the world ends.
lines.zh: 我想，世界末日的时候，那就是我想去的地方。

lines.en: : Okay...I’m here...but this doesn’t really look like a principal’s office to me.
lines.zh: : 好……我到了……可这看起来不太像校长室啊。

lines.en: : I came...just like you asked me to...but I lost the egg along the way and...
lines.zh: : 我来了……就像你要求的那样……可我把鸡蛋弄丢了，而且……
: {i}再深一点……{/i}
: Maya？……
: {i}Akira……干我……{/i}
: {i}干我，Akira……干我！{/i}
: 没用的……

lines.en: : My deer parts don’t work in here.
lines.zh: : 我的鹿的那些部件在这里不管用。
有一个地方。

lines.en: It is a place just like others but this place and it won’t but it is because the place and you don’t understand.
lines.zh: 它跟别的地方一样，只是这个地方，而它不会，但它是，因为那个地方，而你不明白。

lines.en: Each step is a stone and each stone turns to sand so we walk but we’re hard but soft and we’re not and that’s just how the place is sometimes.
lines.zh: 每一步都是一块石头，而每块石头都会变成沙，于是我们走着，可我们坚硬，却又柔软，而我们又不是，而那个地方有时候就是这样的。

lines.en: O, terrible danger. O, big penis sex. O, world and its whirlpool. O, mole ratted necks.
lines.zh: 噢，可怕的危险。噢，大鸡巴性爱。噢，世界和它的漩涡。噢，鼹鼠化了的脖子。

lines.en: O, poetry, pottery, lottery, Shrek. O, rhyming - O, timing - On Dasher, On Deck!
lines.zh: 噢，诗歌、陶艺、彩票、怪物史莱克。噢，押韵——噢，时机——冲啊 Dasher，冲啊 Deck！

lines.en: Your hands aren’t as big as mine. If we put them together, all you’ll notice is how much you need to grow. But what you don’t know is mine are shrinking. They just started out big.
lines.zh: 你的手没有我的大。如果我们把手放在一起，你只会注意到自己还有多少要长。但你不知道的是，我的正在缩小。它们只是起跑时比较大而已。

lines.en: What you don’t know is not all men are fit to be hunters. All men aren’t fit to tell time. Some play the oboe and some sit inside.
lines.zh: 你不知道的是，不是所有男人都适合当猎人。也不是所有男人都适合看时间。有的吹双簧管，有的就那么坐着。

lines.en: But there’s one thing they all have in common.
lines.zh: 但他们有一个共同点。

lines.en: When you strip them, they’re mole rats.
lines.zh: 当你把他们剥光，他们都是鼹鼠。
他们的本能是挖洞。

lines.en: So I think it’s time to start again — from the beginning.
lines.zh: 所以我觉得，是时候重新开始了——从最开头开始。

lines.en: I think it’s time for a new world.
lines.zh: 我觉得，是时候迎来一个新世界了。

lines.en: I think it’s time for a {i}new{/i} world.
lines.zh: 我觉得，是时候迎来一个{i}新{/i}世界了。
{b}新世界。{/b}
: Maya？……
: 是我……Noriko……那个你恨的女孩……

lines.en: : I get that none of this is really happening and that it’s probably just my thoughts manifesting into some dream that I’m going to have to interpret later, but...
lines.zh: : 我知道这一切都不是真的，大概只是我的思绪具象成了一个我回头还得去解的梦，可是……

lines.en: : For the sake of me feeling less worried right now, could you maybe...tell me what you’re crying about?
lines.zh: : 为了让我现在没那么担心，你能不能……告诉我在哭什么？

lines.en: : Everything there is to cry about.
lines.zh: : 所有值得哭的事。

lines.en: : CHAIR GOD, FLARE GOD, MEET ME IN THE AIR GOD. STARE GOD, BEAR GOD, DO YOU HAVE A SPARE GOD?!
lines.zh: : 椅子神，闪光神，与我在空中相见吧神。凝视神，承受神，你有多余的神吗？！

lines.en: : SO MANY PIECES, SO LITTLE TIME. WHY SETTLE FOR THREE WHEN THREE MORE JUST MAKES NINE?
lines.zh: : 碎片那么多，时间那么少。既然再加三个就是九个，何必满足于三个？
: 三加三……
: 其实是六……
: 什么？

lines.en: : Ami, where do you want to go next? Victoria’s Secret? UNIQLO? Or maybe Undercover so Noriko can get lost and we can run away together?
lines.zh: : Ami，接下来想去哪儿？维多利亚的秘密？优衣库？还是 Undercover，好让 Noriko 走丢，我们就能一起私奔了？

lines.en: : Anywhere is fine, Niki. I’m happy enough that you decided to take me out. Never in a million years would I have even {i}dreamed{/i} of going shopping with you.
lines.zh: : 去哪儿都行，Niki。你愿意带我出来，我就已经够开心了。我{i}做梦{/i}都没想过能和你一起逛街。

lines.en: : Oh, shut up. You’re family. Let’s go to Victoria’s Secret. I know people there. I can get you free underwear.
lines.zh: : 哦，闭嘴啦。你是一家人。我们去维多利亚的秘密吧。我在那儿有人。能给你弄到免费的内衣。

lines.en: : Plus, it’ll give us more time to bond since Noriko always wanders off in there and tests the limits of just how much {i}free stuff{/i} I can get. Isn’t that right, Noriko?
lines.zh: : 而且这样我们就有更多时间联络感情了，因为 Noriko 一进那家店就总是乱逛，顺便测试我到底能蹭到多少{i}免费的东西{/i}。我说的对吧，Noriko？
: Noriko？喂？有人在吗？

lines.en: : Hey, is everything okay? You look kinda lost all of a sudden...
lines.zh: : 嘿，你还好吗？你突然看起来有点魂不守舍……
: 哦！呃……没事！
: 那，呃……我们要去{i}哪儿{/i}？
{i}Nao-chan 的好感度提升到了 [nao_love]！{/i}
